description: Calculate the binding total for a list of items with the same code the site checkout uses (prices, minimum order, shipping rules: Nova Poshta for Ukraine; for lang en shipping and VAT by the ship_to country, minimum order 49 EUR excl. VAT). Read-only: creates no order. Use the returned total_minor as expected_total_minor in place_order.

lang.description: Site language and market: uk (Ukrainian, default) and ru (Russian) = Ukraine, prices in UAH, Nova Poshta delivery; en (English, site root) = EU market, prices in EUR, delivery to EU countries (ship_to is required for quote and place_order).

ship_to.description: Delivery destination. Required when lang is en (EU market: shipping and VAT depend on the country); must be omitted for uk and ru (Ukraine: Nova Poshta).

country.description: Delivery country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (DE, PL, FR…)

name: quote
title: Calculate order total
